gen-audiowide-gf-inter-tight: Audiowide draws every curve with one uniform line, its tall lowercase stacked like wide-spaced tiles in a futuristic grid. Inter Tight is the opposite temperament: short ascenders, tails tucked back, tidy sans-serif text.
gen-audiowide-gf-karla: Techy, tile-like, unshaded. Audiowide shines in big, brief headings, while Karla keeps a plain sans body stocky, with a gaping c opening and a tall middle band.
gen-audiowide-gf-kedebideri: Audiowide sets its tall lowercase like tiles with wide gaps, every stroke the same width. Kedebideri follows with a skyward x-height and rounded sans letters that stay open, softening the futuristic edge above.
gen-audiowide-gf-khula: Audiowide has essentially no stroke contrast, just tall lowercase laid out like tiles with generous grout between them. And Khula carries a longer read well, its tall midsection and open curves giving a plain sans body some warmth.
gen-audiowide-gf-krub: Krub reads with a pronounced x-height and pen-lifted curves that leave each loop unfinished, a contemporary sans-serif texture. Audiowide overhead is its tiled, router-cut opposite, futuristic and uniform.
gen-audiowide-gf-kufam: Kufam reads like a single neon tube track, with open curves in its e and bodies that dominate each line. Meanwhile Audiowide adds futuristic tiled lowercase above, a stiffer display sibling to that sans.
gen-audiowide-gf-lexend: Audiowide looks futuristic and techy, all tiled letters.  Its uniform line meets Lexend's outsized lowercase and open-jawed curves, and that plain sans body gives the pair its approachable edge.
gen-audiowide-gf-lexend-deca: Lexend Deca reads plainly, its unshaded line never swelling and its terminals stopping short of curling back. Audiowide brings the futuristic tiles on top, so enlarge the plain sans body a touch to match its big lowercase.
gen-audiowide-gf-liter: Liter reads modern and crisp, with no stroke contrast at all and lowercase that stands tall on wide-mouthed rounds. And Audiowide matches that vertical presence in futuristic tiles, so a slightly larger sans-serif body keeps them level.
gen-audiowide-gf-mada: Audiowide's single unbroken line weight gives it a futuristic, tiled look. Mada follows with curves that refuse to close and a towering midzone, a friendly plain sans that softens the heading's mechanical edge.
